properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sp-core/sp-io ECDSA-over-secp256k1 layer, live in production: recoverable signing (sign_ecdsa_recoverable, ecdsa.rs:754) and public-key recovery exposed as host functions (sp_io secp256k1_ecdsa_recover_compressed), consumed by the contracts pallet Ethereum-compat path, BEEFY validator-set proofs, runtime MultiSignature, statement-store Secp256k1Ecdsa proofs, Secp256k1HDKD derivation; crates secp256k1 0.24 + libsecp256k1 0.7. Quantum-unsafe (Shor); changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: k256@0.13.1, the pure-Rust secp256k1/ECDSA implementation, declared for frame-support with the ecdsa feature — an independent ECDSA-secp256k1 path in the build alongside the libsecp256k1 bindings.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA across the stack: sp-io host functions (ecdsa_sign/verify/verify_prehashed/verify_deprecated), keystore backends (local + testing), BEEFY authority scheme (app_crypto, sign_prehashed), runtime MultiSignature/MultiSigner, application-crypto wrappers, statement-store STATEMENT proofs, CLI CryptoScheme::Ecdsa. Live production signature scheme; mocks/benches/tests exercise the same real scheme.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live X25519 ECDH in statement-store ECIES (ecies.rs:74-109): ephemeral StaticSecret from OsRng, diffie_hellman shared secret, HKDF-SHA256 → AES-256-GCM; plus ed25519→Montgomery conversion (96-99) and x25519-dalek 2.0.0/curve25519-dalek 4.0.0 deps. The only asymmetric key agreement in the tree — the highest-value harvest-now-decrypt-later asset; changeable here (ML-KEM-768).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ed25519-dalek@1.0.1 (+ the ed25519 signature-trait crate) pinned in Cargo.lock — the Ed25519 provider behind sp-core's live ed25519 module; dependency inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: curve25519-dalek@2.1.3 in Cargo.lock — the curve library under the live X25519 ECIES path (ed25519→Montgomery conversion in ecies.rs) and the dalek/schnorrkel layers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256/512 (Ethereum-compatible) in live use: sp-core-hashing keccak_256/512 + proc-macros, sp-io host functions and KeccakHasher trie roots/proofs, BEEFY signature hasher (BeefyAuthorityId<Keccak256>), contracts pallet seal_hash_keccak_256, identity pallet Data::Keccak256, binary-merkle-tree proofs. Quantum-safe hashes; several sites are benches/tests, which still count as presence.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: blake2b live via blake2b_simd in sp-core-hashing (blake2_64/256/512 — BlakeTwo256 is Substrate's default runtime hasher), runtime-API ID hashing, bitswap CID multihash, glutton pallet, ss58 checksum (crypto.rs:377 Blake2b512). Quantum-safe hashes.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256-GCM AEAD live in statement-store ECIES: Aes256Gcm::new encrypt/decrypt (ecies.rs:51/58), generate_nonce(OsRng) (82); aes-gcm crate. Quantum-safe symmetric half — the X25519 key agreement is the vulnerable part of this ECIES construction.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HKDF-SHA256 live in statement-store ECIES: Hkdf::<Sha256>::new(None, shared_secret).expand(b\"\", aes_key) (ecies.rs:64-66) derives the AES-256 key from the X25519 shared secret; hkdf 0.12 dep.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hmac@0.8.1 in Cargo.lock — pulled as the PRF inside the live BIP39 PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 seed derivation (substrate-bip39 → sp-core Pair::from_phrase). Dependency with a live consumer.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@0.8.0 in Cargo.lock, pulled by substrate-bip39. Its live use — sp-core Pair::from_phrase → substrate_bip39::seed_from_entropy (primitives/core/src/crypto.rs:882), 2048 BIP39 iterations — is reported as a separate finding (CWE-916 territory).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha2 crate in Cargo.lock, live in-tree: HKDF-SHA256 in ECIES (ecies.rs:64), Sha512 in the ECIES ed25519→x25519 key conversion (ecies.rs:120-125), sp_io hashing::sha2_256 host function, BIP39 HMAC-SHA512.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: blake3@1.3.3 pinned in Cargo.lock — dependency inventory; quantum-safe hash present in the build (transitive provider surface).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES at 256-bit live in statement-store ECIES (Aes256Gcm with 32-byte AES_KEY_LEN) — Grover leaves a 128-bit security margin; the A+ rating stands.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: chacha20poly1305 crate declared in the workspace Cargo.toml release profile — no call site anywhere in the tree (grep over all .rs files: zero hits). The AEAD ships in the build whether or not it is called; if it is dead weight, pruning the dependency is the remediation.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha2 library live: primitives/core/hashing/src/lib.rs (sha2_256 host function), statement-store ecies.rs (Sha256-based HKDF, Sha512 key conversion), pinned in Cargo.lock.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: md-5@0.10.5 in Cargo.lock — transitive dependency only; MD5 is cryptographically broken (CWE-328 collision attacks), and a grep over every .rs file in the tree finds zero call sites. Candidate for pruning from the dependency graph.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: curve25519-dalek@2.1.3 in Cargo.lock; live at primitives/statement-store/src/ecies.rs:96-99 (CompressedEdwardsY → to_montgomery ed25519→x25519 conversion for ECIES) and underneath the dalek/schnorrkel layers.
